_comment: 088: pre-registered adoption gate for the finish_decomp bundle (frozen BEFORE any OOS run, 憲法 III). Every threshold below is a REAL key (the canonical hash strips '_'-prefixed keys, so anything written only in a _comment is NOT hash-protected and is silently ignored by the harness — 069's own warning). Values are inherited verbatim from the 069/073 lineage so this verdict is directly comparable with the 069 ADOPT and 070 REJECT decisions. Do NOT edit after the OOS run (confirmatory mode rejects a hash mismatch).

subgroup_guard._comment: intersection-union: ADOPT requires ALL critical subgroups PASS. Coverage bands are NOT part of the guard for 088 — 069's cov_* bands are defined on F02 market observation counts (asof_pm_obs_count), which paired-eval does not inject and which are unrelated to this bundle's finished-run history (analyze 3周目 C1). The finished-run coverage structure is reported by the FR-018 column x year audit instead.

eval_window._comment: Scored-race window, frozen pre-OOS. from=2019-01-01 matches 069/070/073 verbatim so 088's verdict is comparable with the neighbouring bundles' ADOPT/REJECT; the fold structure is unchanged (first_valid_year=2008 => 19 walk-forward folds, FR-011). to=2026-08-09 is the data_through at freeze time.

bootstrap._comment: Race-day cluster bootstrap, seed/b pinned as REAL keys so a CLI override cannot change them (the harness reads the config first). seed 20260713 is the 069/070/073 value — same estimator, comparable CIs.

arms._comment: Pre-registered paired-eval arms (recipe specs, both refit per fold; no saved booster is consumed). The baseline drops EXACTLY the bundle under test, so the paired difference is attributable to finish_decomp alone (069 drop=group method).

verdict._comment: The single source of truth for the 088 verdict (FR-013a): report['gate']['adopted'] AND report['subgroups']['subgroup_guard']. The harness's own report['decision'] is the 073 tri-value and is a REFERENCE value only — it returns NO_DECISION for underpowered cases (e.g. a CI straddling zero) where this formula says REJECT (070 precedent). On divergence the formula wins and the decision value + cause are recorded alongside it.
